Schnittstelle Sequence<A>

Typparameter:
A - the element type
Alle Superschnittstellen:
org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher1<Sequence.µ, A>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Hkt<Sequence.µ>, Seq<A>
Alle bekannten Implementierungsklassen:
Sequence.Element, Sequence.Empty
public sealed interface Sequence<A> extends Seq<A>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher1<Sequence.µ, A> permits Sequence.Element<A>, Sequence.Empty<A>

A functional, immutable sequence of elements of type A. This interface represents a singly linked list structure with lazy evaluation of element values via Provider.

Characteristics:

  • Immutability: All operations return a new sequence without modifying the original.
  • Stack-Safety: Recursive operations (like filter(Predicate) or reverse()) are implemented using Trampoline to prevent StackOverflowError on long sequences.
  • Encounter-Order: Methods preserve the order of elements as they were provided during construction.
  • Laziness: While the structure (links between elements) is eager in the current implementation, the values themselves are supplied lazily.
Seit:
1.0.0

      @SafeVarargs static <A> Sequence<A> sequenceOf(@NonNull A... elements)

      Contract: The elements are stored in the order they appear in the array. Input array and all elements must not be null.

      Gibt zurück:

    • filter

      @UnwindingOperation default @NonNull Sequence<A> filter(@NonNull Predicate<? super A> predicate)

      Filters this sequence by the given predicate, returning a sequence with only the elements that satisfy the predicate.
